description: Counts devices observed by a Bugfender app that match the supplied filters.

app_id.description: Public app ID returned by list_apps.

current_app_version.description: Filter by app version ID returned by list_app_versions.

device_id.description: Filter by device UID/UDID. Use * as a suffix wildcard for a prefix match.

device_key_values.description: Filter by custom device data (for example, tier=pro).

enabled.description: Filter by enabled (true) or disabled (false) devices.

name: count_devices

data.description: Tool-specific result data, present when ok is true.

error.description: Error details, present when ok is false.

hint.description: Optional recovery guidance that does not expose credentials.

ok.description: True on success and false on failure.

pagination.description: Pagination state for retrieving more results.

title: Count App Devices
